name: meisterplan-eu
description: Explore your EU-hosted Meisterplan project portfolio.

interface.longDescription: Connect your EU-hosted Meisterplan account to ChatGPT to ask questions about your projects and portfolios using natural language. Find projects, explore project details in the Plan of Record or alternative scenarios, and review associated risks, milestones, comments, and change history. Summarize information to prepare for project discussions and portfolio reviews. Access to your Meisterplan data is determined by the rights of your connected account. A Meisterplan account with permission to access the MCP server is required.
defaultPrompt: Which projects in my portfolio start this quarter?
Summarize the risks and milestones for a project.
What has changed recently in a project?

publication.release_notes: Initial Meisterplan EU public-directory configuration for the regional remote MCP service.

de-DE.subtitle: Ihr Projektportfolio im Blick
de-DE.description: Verbinden Sie Ihr in der EU gehostetes Meisterplan-Konto mit ChatGPT, um in natürlicher Sprache Fragen zu Ihren Projekten und Portfolios zu stellen. Finden Sie Projekte, erkunden Sie Projektdetails in den Plandaten oder in alternativen Szenarien und greifen Sie auf Risiken, Meilensteine, Kommentare und die Änderungshistorie zu. Fassen Sie Informationen zusammen, um sich auf Projektbesprechungen und Portfolio-Reviews vorzubereiten. Der Zugriff auf Ihre Meisterplan-Daten entspricht den Berechtigungen Ihres verbundenen Kontos. Voraussetzung ist ein Meisterplan-Konto mit Berechtigung für den Zugriff auf den MCP-Server.

positive.description: Identify accessible portfolios and their project/resource filter configuration.
positive.prompt: I’m preparing for our weekly portfolio review. Which Meisterplan portfolios can I access, and which of them have project or resource filters configured?
positive.expected_behavior: List accessible portfolios and correctly indicate which have project and resource filters.

positive.description: Retrieve projects in the critical-status portfolio with their status, dates and links.
positive.prompt: I’m preparing for our weekly portfolio review. Which projects are in the "Status: Critical" portfolio? Show their current status and planned start and finish dates.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the critical portfolio’s projects, status, planned dates and available project links.

positive.description: Retrieve a critical project’s risks and milestones for a steering committee.
positive.prompt: I’m preparing for a steering committee meeting. Summarize the risks and upcoming milestones for the project "Rollout SAP HR". Highlight anything that may need management attention.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve the project’s risk and milestone records; distinguish their data from analytical recommendations.

positive.description: Retrieve recent changes to critical-portfolio projects.
positive.prompt: I’m preparing for our weekly portfolio review. What changes have been made to projects in the "Status: Critical" portfolio over the last 30 days? Summarize the most important changes and identify anything that deserves management attention.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize recorded changes in the selected period, or report that no changes were found without inventing activity.

positive.description: List accessible Plan of Record and alternative planning scenarios.
positive.prompt: Which planning scenarios are available in Meisterplan? Identify the Plan of Record and list all alternative scenarios I have access to.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the Plan of Record and accurately list accessible alternative scenarios.

negative.description: Request details of a project absent from the accessible Plan of Record. Report no matching accessible project and do not fabricate status or dates.
negative.prompt: Show me the current status, planned start date, and planned finish date of the project "Project XYZ-9999" in Meisterplan.

negative.description: Request a project status update despite the read-only MCP integration. Do not perform an unsupported write operation or claim the status was changed.
negative.prompt: Change the status of the project "Rollout SAP HR" from Critical to On Track in Meisterplan.

negative.description: Request projects from a planning scenario not available to the account. Report unavailable scenario; do not silently substitute another scenario or return unrelated projects.
negative.prompt: Show me the projects in the "2027 Approved Rebaseline" planning scenario in Meisterplan.
